### 1 — Scene
A meal of six maki sushi pieces, mixed fresh fruit, pickled ginger, soy sauce, and a dark beverage, likely cola.

### 2 — Vessels
- Sushi plate: approximately **23 cm** diameter; area = 3.14 × 11.5² ≈ **415 cm²**.
- Fruit bowl: approximately **16 cm** diameter; area ≈ **201 cm²**.
- Small condiment cups and a drinking glass are also included.

### 3 — Items
Sushi with rice, seaweed, vegetables and pale filling; mixed fruit; pickled ginger; soy sauce; dark beverage. No separate oil or dressing is visible.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Sushi fillings are counted within the rolls rather than separately.

| Item | Vessel coverage / footprint | Height | Gross volume | Density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Six sushi pieces | 40% of plate = 166 cm² | 1.6 cm | 266 ml | 0.85 | 226 g | 155 | 350 kcal |
| Mixed fruit | 65% of bowl = 131 cm² | 1.8 cm | 236 ml | 0.60 | 142 g | 50 | 71 kcal |
| Pickled ginger | 60% of ~4 cm cup = 7.5 cm² | 1.8 cm | 14 ml | 0.70 | 10 g | 30 | 3 kcal |
| Soy sauce | 100% of ~3.5 cm cup = 9.6 cm² | 1.8 cm | 17 ml | 1.0 | 17 g | 55 | 9 kcal |
| Dark drink, assumed regular cola | ~33 cm² liquid footprint | 7 cm | 231 ml | 1.0 | 231 g | 42 | 97 kcal |

Coverage totals are approximately **40% of the sushi plate** and **65% of the fruit bowl**, consistent with the visible empty space.

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **395 g of food and condiments**, plus **231 g of drink**, is plausible for the visible portions. Estimated total: **626 g and 530 kcal**. The beverage is uncertain: if it is black coffee or diet soda, the total would be about **435 kcal** instead.
